nui 1
record Inner(paths: path[], p: path, n: number)
record Middle(inner: Inner, n: number)
record Outer(middle: Middle, n: number)
module Relay(packet: Outer) {
 const Whole: Outer = @packet
 const Alias: path[] = @Whole.middle.inner.paths
 export const out: path = @Alias[1]
 export const p: path = @Whole.middle.inner.p
 export const size: number = @Alias.length
 export const tag: number = @Whole.middle.inner.n + @Whole.middle.n + @Whole.n
}
module Make(items: path[], p: path, n: number) {
 const I: Inner = Inner(paths: @items, p: @p, n: @n)
 const M: Middle = Middle(inner: @I, n: @n + 100)
 const O: Outer = Outer(middle: @M, n: @n + 200)
 const Whole: Outer = @O
 instance Forward = Relay(packet: @Whole)
 export const out: path = @Forward::out
 export const p: path = @Forward::p
 export const size: number = @Forward::size
 export const tag: number = @Forward::tag
}
const P: path = segment(start: (0, 0), end: (3, 4))
const Q: path = segment(start: (0, 0), end: (5, 12))
const Values: path[] = [@P, @Q]
const Reverse: path[] = [@Q, @P, @Q]
instance One = Make(items: @Values, p: @P, n: 17)
instance Two = Make(items: @Reverse, p: @Q, n: 41)
const First: path = @One::out
const Second: path = @Two::out
const Third: path = @One::p
const Fourth: path = @Two::p
const L: number = @First.length
const M: number = @Second.length
const X: number = @Third.length
const Y: number = @Fourth.length
const C: number = @One::size
const D: number = @Two::size
const N: number = @One::tag
const O: number = @Two::tag
reason: Module Make exported p collides with parameter p; consequent unresolved declarations are not discovery families.
